caller.condition: Expand current macro, insert its returned form before remaining forms; add-macro and add-declarations complete before recursion
Leading definition scan expands macros in order; after first nondefinition it defers forms with their environment
Expression macro expands recursively; expander return is not proof that all arbitrary effects are cacheable
Evaluating expander definition may itself have effects; installation and invocation are separate event occurrences
Gerbil iter transformer uses binding/marks/phase context before generated Scheme reaches Gambit; do not merge the two macro engines

delivery.condition: EventId includes semantic invocation/activation, ordinal and owner domain; retry of one event retains identity; new invocation is not a duplicate
Managed registry root transition and immutable event receipt commit under one authority; current helpers have no such ledger
Lost acknowledgement retrieves exact committed receipt; unavailable authoritative state means retain custody and block automatic effect replay
Preserve completed registration prefix on error; existing handler/scope restoration is not a registry transaction rollback
Transport retry is not semantic continuation replay; new legitimate activation may register again; root/unknown holders must drain explicitly

route.condition: Duplicate delivery of same semantic EventId leaves registry unchanged and returns same receipt
Equal names/payloads in distinct real occurrences remain separate ordered registrations
Later form sees registry after all preceding committed effects; cached output alone is not that receipt
Failure does not erase committed prefix or unknown delivery responsibility
Unknown delivery and retained continuation keep result/root custody until resolved

gain.avoided: Repeated registration after acknowledgement loss in managed delivery
gain.added: Event ledger, identity, retained receipt and authoritative resolution
gain.condition: Existing raw helper calls cannot gain this property without replacing actual write authority

Exception observer, semantic activation identity, root/multishot continuation lifetime

gate.condition: All actual macro eval/call effects, binding and native reachability admitted
Registry transition and EventId/receipt journal share a truthful authoritative commit
Full parser queue, nested scopes and deferred body forms refine event order
Macro result/source/marks/diagnostics/effects and context reconstruction equivalent

All direct/indirect registry writers and real consumers migrate; no second global authority
Native synchronization, GC/FFI, host registration and measured performance remain unqualified
